items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I met Eddie in 1948 or 1949 when he had an apartment on Montclair with Marian Sampler and Cal Bailey... [INTERVIEWEE] It was the three of them.

ctx.x: so much of my mother, took me into their home, and treated me just like a second son. After that, my first meeting with Eddie Beal, we rented an apartment together, we rented an apartment together. This was way back in the very late Thirties. So we rented this apartment, and two weeks later Eddie Beal got married and moved out, so he never stayed there. Eddie Beal is one of my favorite characters, incidentally.

Yeah, mine too. Well, at that apartment... I met Eddie in 1948 or 1949 when he had an apartment on Montclair with Marian Sampler and Cal Bailey, (Marian Sampler, the fine artist, and Cal Bailey was also an artist), and was there anybody else... I guess it was the three of them who had that apartment.
It was the three of them.
